_approach: Funk bruxaria's skeletal, stomping baile funk logic: punchy downbeat kicks, clipped claps and swung hats, ghost notes kept deliberately sparse so every hit lands heavy, per the genre's 2023-26 dark/occult wave. A cowbell 'bell toll' accent and a low tom hit stand in for the ritual chimes and foley the style favours. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
